caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a chest of drawers or a sideboard. It is rectangular in shape and stands on four straight cylindrical legs. The top surface is flat and extends slightly beyond the body, with an extra rounded drop-leaf extension on the left side, which is also finished in the same light brown tone.
